targetedKeywords.note: Researched Spanish search terms, not literal translations. Trucking vocabulary varies by region (see translatorNotes).
primary: reducir llamadas de estado de envíos

translatorNotes: Register: informal tú, consistent with the rest of the Spanish site.

FLAG — trucking/logistics vocabulary varies between Spain and Latin America and should be checked by a native reviewer for the target market. Choices used here: shipment -> envío; load/freight -> carga; dispatch (the desk/function) -> central; dispatcher(s)/operator -> operador(es); carrier -> transportista; broker -> bróker (plural brókeres); driver -> conductor; delivery -> entrega; check calls -> llamadas de control (concept not used verbatim in this post); 'where is my shipment' -> '¿dónde está mi envío?'. In parts of LatAm 'despacho/despachador', 'camionero/chofer', and 'corredor de carga' may read more naturally than central/operador/conductor/bróker.

Acronyms kept as-is: TMS, WMS, SMS, API. This post does not use the acronyms POD or ETA literally in the body (source says 'expected delivery window', rendered 'ventana de entrega prevista'), so the one-time glosses 'comprobante de entrega (POD)' and 'hora estimada de llegada (ETA)' were not needed. If a reviewer introduces those acronyms, gloss each once on first use.

Currency: 'between one thousand and five thousand dollars' -> 'entre 1.000 y 5.000 dólares'. 'low hundreds of dollars' -> 'los cientos bajos de dólares'. Read time '9 min read' -> '9 min de lectura'. Date 'August 8, 2026' -> '8 de agosto de 2026'. article:section 'Logistics' -> 'Logística'.
Brand/tool names kept: Twilio, n8n, Make, Zapier, Innovaria Tech Limited. Email info@innovariatech.space and phone +1 601 860 1258 unchanged.

Internal links repointed to /es (brand, nav, breadcrumbs, services, industries, case-studies, about, blog, contact, related-reading, inline CTAs, footer). Left unchanged: /privacy, /terms, sitemap.xml, mailto, tel, the LinkedIn author URL and the Unsplash image URLs.
